nodes.name: Schedule Trigger
nodes.notes: 01:00 UTC daily (workflow timezone is UTC). f_payment is loaded at 00:00 UTC with yesterday's data, so the run must not start before 00:30 UTC.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Deployment settings. slackChannelId is the channel ID (C...), set on the instance; the bot of the Slack API credential must be a member of that channel.

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "QueryString": "-- ============================================================
-- Ручные депозиты ManualDeposit за вчера (UTC) - ежедневная выгрузка в Slack
-- Колонки повторяют выгрузку транзакций UBO.
--
-- Логика:
--   f_payment, payment_method_name = 'ManualDeposit' (provider_name = 'Backoffice',
--   is_manual = true). Это оба типа ручного зачисления:
--     adjustment deposit + reason 3 'Compensation'      - компенсации (~95 %)
--     deposit            + reason 9 'Courier deposit'   - бывают в USDT / ETH / TRX
--   Стримеры и тестовые НЕ исключаются (так просили). SBNORM (песочница) исключен.
--
-- Поля UBO -> данные (сверено по двум транзакциям из UBO от 26.10.2026):
--   ID               = apm_order_id (transaction_id у ручных пуст)
--   Created/Updated  = action_ts / update_ts, UTC. В UBO те же транзакции на 4 часа позже
--   Creating Reason  = ref_apm_transaction_reasons.reason по reason_id + transaction_type
--   Transaction type = в данных 'adjustment deposit', в UBO у тех же строк 'deposit'
--   Currency         = amount_currency: в данных RUB, в UBO 'SHU'
--   Notes            = comment (creation_comment пуст у всех)
--   Risk casino seg  = сегмент на момент транзакции (f_payment), не текущий
--   In Promo, Bonus Applied - в Athena нет, убраны (Иван, 2026-11-05)
--
-- Решения Ивана 2026-11-05: сутки UTC, вчера целиком; тип и валюта как в данных;
--   SBNORM исключен; сегмент на момент операции.
--
-- ВАЖНО: f_payment грузится раз в сутки в 00:00 UTC данными по вчера -
--        расписание ставить не раньше 00:30 UTC.
--        В SQL нет знака вопроса.
--
-- Диалект: Trino / Athena. Таблицы указаны как database.table (каталог AwsDataCatalog
-- задаётся в QueryExecutionContext, DBeaver-овский префикс "Athena-bebohuex" здесь не нужен).
-- ============================================================

with params as (
    select date_add('day', -1, current_date) as day_from,
           current_date                      as day_to_excl
),

md as (
    -- ручные депозиты за сутки, одна строка на заказ (страховка от дублей)
    select fp.*,
           row_number() over (partition by fp.apm_order_id order by fp.update_ts desc) as rn
    from operator_ro_normcasino.f_payment fp
    cross join params p
    where fp.action_date >= p.day_from
      and fp.action_date <  p.day_to_excl
      and fp.payment_method_name = 'ManualDeposit'
      and fp.brand <> 'SBNORM'
)

select md.apm_order_id                                        as "ID",
       upper(cast(md.is_manual as varchar))                   as "Manual",
       md.player_id                                           as "Player ID",
       md.brand                                               as "Brand",
       md.player_risk_casino_segment_name                     as "Risk casino segment",
       date_format(md.action_ts, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')         as "Created",
       date_format(md.update_ts, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')         as "Updated",
       r.reason                                               as "Creating Reason",
       md.transaction_type                                    as "Transaction type",
       md.status                                              as "Transaction status",
       cast(md.paid_amount as double)                         as "Paid amount",
       md.amount_currency                                     as "Currency",
       md.modified_by                                         as "Modified by",
       md.decline_reason_message                              as "Decline reason",
       md.comment                                             as "Notes",
       md.payment_method_name                                 as "Payment method"
from md
left join operator_ro_normcasino.ref_apm_transaction_reasons r
       on r.reason_id = md.reason_id
      and r.transaction_type = md.transaction_type
where md.rn = 1
order by md.action_ts desc",
  "QueryExecutionContext": { "Database": "{{ $('Config').first().json.athenaDatabase }}", "Catalog": "{{ $('Config').first().json.athenaCatalog || 'AwsDataCatalog' }}" },
  "WorkGroup": "{{ $('Config').first().json.athenaWorkgroup || 'primary' }}",
  "ClientRequestToken": "n8n-manual-deposits-export-execution-{{ $execution.id }}"
  {{ $('Config').first().json.athenaOutputLocation ? ', "ResultConfiguration": { "OutputLocation": "' + $('Config').first().json.athenaOutputLocation + '" }' : '' }}
}

nodes.name: Execute Athena Query
nodes.notes: ClientRequestToken is derived from the execution id, so a retry of this node rejoins the same Athena query instead of starting a second one.

nodes.name: Poll Attempts Remaining?
nodes.notes: true -> wait and poll again; false -> give up after 120 polls (~10 min)

parameters.errorMessage: =Athena query {{ $('Execute Athena Query').first().json.QueryExecutionId }} did not finish within the polling budget of 120 polls x 5 s (~10 minutes). Last observed state: {{ $json.QueryExecution.Status.State }}. Nothing was sent to Slack.

=Athena query {{ $json.QueryExecution.QueryExecutionId }} ended in state {{ $json.QueryExecution.Status.State }}. Reason: {{ $json.QueryExecution.Status.StateChangeReason || 'no StateChangeReason returned by Athena' }}. Nothing was sent to Slack.

nodes.name: Get Athena Results Page
nodes.notes: Runs once per page: first from Athena Query State (no nextToken), then from More Pages? with the previous page's nextToken.

nodes.name: More Pages?
nodes.notes: true -> fetch the next page; false -> all pages read

nodes.name: Rows Found?
nodes.notes: true -> build the spreadsheet and upload it; false -> post a short notice that there were no manual deposits

nodes.name: Convert to XLSX
nodes.notes: All input items become one .xlsx in binary property "data". XLSX rather than CSV so the file opens in Excel with any locale and "Paid amount" stays numeric.

nodes.name: Get Slack Upload URL
nodes.notes: Step 1 of 3 of Slack's external upload. Needs the Slack API credential (bot token, scope files:write).

nodes.name: Upload File to Slack
nodes.notes: Step 2 of 3: raw file bytes to the one-time upload_url. No auth: the URL itself is the credential. Slack answers with plain text, not JSON.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ files: [{ id: $('Check Upload URL').first().json.file_id, title: $('Check Upload URL').first().json.title }], channel_id: $('Check Upload URL').first().json.channelId, initial_comment: $('Check Upload URL').first().json.initialComment }) }}

nodes.name: Complete Slack Upload
nodes.notes: Step 3 of 3: shares the file in the channel with the summary as the message text. Can only be called once per file_id.

nodes.name: Post Empty Notice
nodes.notes: Zero rows for the day: post the summary line without a file, so a silent day is distinguishable from a failed run. Needs scope chat:write.
